otherFindings.summary: The "Astana" time zone now maps to Asia/Almaty (UTC+5) instead of UTC+6, which shifts reminders and displayed times.
Action Text plain-text conversion now drops script/style text and renumbers ordered lists, which changes exported Markdown.
Rails' built-in Sidekiq adapter is deprecated (removal in 8.2); moving to Sidekiq 7.3.3+ brings redis-client behavior changes.
Trix now comes from the action_text-trix gem (Trix 2), so its stylesheet may not match the vendored Trix 1.3.5 script.
